cues.note: Dusk on the avenue then the hut: city murmur + wind in the lattice, antenna wires hum rising during the crane, inside the hut room tone + lantern hiss
dissolve in from the cafe laugh: laugh tails off, low cold string note
sledge rests on a shoulder: cloth + metal tick; a crowbar scrapes the cobbles
snap push on 'ใกล้วันรื้อ': short whoosh + low drum hit
Eiffel's face drops to worry: small wobble sting (no voice)
crane up the tower: rising string/wind riser, iron creak, wire hum
WHIP-TILT down the wire: fast falling whoosh with a thin wire zing, lands on the post
dive to the hut: air rush, the lit window grows, spark crackle starts faintly
passing through the window: a brief wooden thump + room tone switch to interior
hard cut to shot 21 (night): the last zap becomes the signal-ring swell
